_source.title: PCB 对比
_source.params.pcb1: PCB 1，可以为：①当前工程内的 PCB 的 UUID；②其它工程的工程 UUID 和 PCB UUID；③PCB 文件数据
_source.params.pcb2: PCB 2，可以为：①当前工程内的 PCB 的 UUID；②其它工程的工程 UUID 和 PCB UUID；③PCB 文件数据

title: PCB comparison
params.pcb1: PCB 1, which can be: 1. The UUID of a PCB in the current project; 2. The project UUID and PCB UUID of another project; 3. PCB file data
params.pcb2: PCB 2, which can be: 1. The UUID of a PCB in the current project; 2. The project UUID and PCB UUID of another project; 3. PCB file data
returns: PCB comparison response: when `success = true`, `data` is the comparison result; when `success = false`, `error` contains the error code and message
